note: The parts and contracts of this product, each by pin: repository, path, version, commit and SHA-256 (49GAION/DR-0025, item 3). The pins equal the Library register of 49GAION-protocol at d44e4fc. tools/check_pins.py reads every file back at its commit, checks its SHA-256, and checks each part's pin against its row in the Library register at the shared test's commit (TEST-DESIGN-CHAIN v2, case 10). A new version of a part moves only its pin here, and the shared test runs again. On 25 October 2026 (49GAION/DR-0044; decisions/DR-0003) the pins of three parts, and of the sockets contract drafts, moved to the parts' own mother repositories at their merged commits; every SHA-256 is unchanged. On 29 October 2026 (decisions/DR-0005) the pins of the four parts moved to their releases that carry 49GAION/DR-0049 (positions only), at their merged commits, with their new SHA-256; the contract pins are unchanged.

parts.fixed_test: TEST-SL v1 (95 cases), keeping TEST-SOURCE-LIFECYCLE v4
TEST-TOM v5 (123 cases), keeping TEST-TARGET-OPERATING-MODEL v3
TEST-PPD v3 (110 live cases); the Library card names TEST-PROCESS-AND-POSITION-DESIGN v4, which the mother maps only at v2 (upstream/PROPOSALS.md, item 8)
TEST-DI v1 (94 cases), keeping TEST-DELIVERY-AND-IMPLEMENTATION v1; the Library card names v3 (upstream/PROPOSALS.md, item 8)
